newsitem.title: USA: Scios, Lilly in Alzheimer's pact.
newsitem.headline: Scios, Lilly in Alzheimer's pact.

text.p: Eli Lilly and Co and Scios Inc said they signed an agreement establishing a research collaboration in the area of Alzheimer's disease.
Lilly will fund research at Scios and have the first opportunity to develop products from the collaboration, the companies said.
Scios may develop other products from the collaboration and the commercializing partner will make milestone and royalty payments to the other partner, they said.
Both firms may use the technology developed in the program. Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed.

"The goal of the partnership is to produce pharmaceuticals which prevent or retard the progression of the disease. One aspect of the collaboration will be the development of screening assays to identify compounds useful in the treatment of Alzheimer's disease," the companies said.
